diagnosis.failed_condition: The preregistration required das.verify_head to pass at resid:10. That helper compares the direct lm_head readout of the captured state with the full model's final logits, so it necessarily includes the omitted effects of blocks 10-17 and is not an exactness test for an intermediate linear functional.
diagnosis.why_not_contaminating: The resid10 feature is defined exactly as a fixed lm_head-weight contrast applied to the captured intermediate state. It is not claimed to equal the native final margin, used as a denominator, or used for capability. Its failure to reconstruct the suffix output does not alter the feature, fitted coefficients, resid18 patch, or any scored endpoint.
diagnosis.required_language_correction: Call the feature a fixed intermediate unembedding contrast, not native confidence or an exact-head replay. A true exactness control would compare two implementations of that same local functional, not compare it with the post-suffix model.

interpretation: A four-parameter read-compute-write interface from the v11 initial resid10 variable predicts a selective later rank-one carrier intervention without reading the confirmation resid18 margin. Because the confirmation population was previously used for the final-margin controller and the feature still uses lm_head weights, this is a causal screen rather than complete upstream identification.
next_action: Freeze the two resid10 fits and validate them on a second unseen lexicon, using a local functional identity control rather than final-logit equality.
